headlines.title: THE MARKETS: STOCKS; Technology Heavyweights Push Nasdaq Index Up 3.4%
THE MARKETS; Nasdaq Market at 5,000: Volatility as Way of Life
headlines.abstract: Analysis of Nasdaq composite index's close above 5,000; says move upward has been largely concentrated in only handful of sectors within market--biotechnology, computer technology and telecommunications; holds other sectors have generally lost value as Federal Reserve's push to up interest rates has taken a toll; says while most stocks are falling, enthusiasm for 'new economy,' dominated by Internet, has only increased among investors in recent months; and performance of those stocks has not matched that of biotechnology issues, which have suddenly come alive in their strongest performance since 1992; chart (M)

headlines.title: DATABANK: MARCH 6-10; Nasdaq, Still Chugging, Passes 5,000
headlines.abstract: Nasdaq composite index, which includes many Internet start-ups, vaults past 5,000, finishing week at 5,048.62, up 133.83; graphs (M)
